fieldValues.title: A problem may have no cluster, or a cluster of its own
fieldValues.decision_question: Must every problem sit in a cluster?
fieldValues.context: Relayed from the owner on 2026-10-11, after the Writing domain container left five suggested problems unclustered (srs-programme#105); awaiting ratification.
fieldValues.decision_statement: A problem may sit in a domain with no cluster. Where a cluster is required, a cluster holding a single problem is valid. Clusters are provisional groupings: problems move between them as understanding of the domain changes.
fieldValues.rationale: Early in a domain we are not aware of all its parts; forcing a grouping before it is understood fixes a premature arrangement. Clusters are named meaning that evolves (affirm meaning over arrangement).
fieldValues.revisit_when: When the share of unclustered problems in a walked domain stays high across several synthesiser runs, or an objective cannot address work because its problems are unclustered.
